question.html:
The ends of a vertical column of water are maintained at different temperatures Tt and Tb both above the freezing point.

Energy transfer by radiation in this arrangement is negligible.

a Discuss the mechanism that accounts for the greatest rate of energy transfer when:

a.i Tt > Tb [2]

a.ii Tb > Tt [2]

b The liquid now freezes so that the vertical column is entirely of ice. Suggest how your answer to (a)(ii) will change. [2]
